Wide landscape composition, objects within central 80 percent for crop. No words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, flags or portraits. One scene, no collage. This is a conceptual model, not historical documentary evidence or a statistical comparison. An empty planning room as a detailed miniature: a large ivory central desk holds several layered blue maps with visible incomplete gaps and disconnected paths; three blank framed maps hang behind; one small red model bridge waits unplaced. The incomplete information is conveyed by gaps in paths, not text. No futuristic screens.
